source_name: Privredna komora Kosova i Metohije (Serbian-language chamber, Kosovska Mitrovica)
why_relevant: The only Serbian-language chamber structure covering Serb-majority municipalities in Kosovo; enumerates firms that operate under the parallel/Serbian system and would otherwise be invisible in ARBK-only actor maps. Its links page points onward to Serbian registers (APR) relevant for cross-registered entities.

source_name: RKS Open Data — organisation pages (e.g. Komisioni Rregullativ i Prokurimit Publik)
why_relevant: The national open-data portal organises datasets by publishing institution, which doubles as a machine-readable list of state bodies (i.e. contracting authorities) and exposes any procurement or registry datasets they publish.

source_name: Gzk.rks-gov.net — Gazeta Zyrtare (legal basis defining registers and chambers)
why_relevant: Law No. 04/L-093 on banks, MFIs and NBFIs defines which entity types must be licensed and registered by BQK; Law No. 2004/7 defines the Chamber; Law No. 04/L-042 defines contracting authorities. These texts tell you what the registers must contain and therefore what is collectable by right.

source_name: ARBK Registri i Pengut (pledge register)
why_relevant: Pledge/collateral register operated alongside ARBK; reveals financing relationships between banks/MFIs and companies, an indirect signal of which institutions are active with which corporate counterparties.

source_name: KosovaJob.com — Kosovo's largest job board (bank/IT/procurement vacancies)
why_relevant: Kosovo banks (ProCredit, Raiffeisen, TEB, NLB, BKT, Banka Ekonomike, BPB, Credins) post IT, project-manager, procurement and vendor-management vacancies here. Role titles such as 'menaxher projekti', 'zyrtar i prokurimit', 'core banking' or 'kartela/pagesa' reveal in-flight programmes months before any award notice.

source_name: DuaPune.com — Kosovo job portal, project-manager category
why_relevant: Second major Albanian-language vacancy aggregator for Kosovo, with a dedicated 'Menaxher Projektesh' subcategory. Aggregates postings from banks, PSPs and their local IT integrators, i.e. both buyer-side and vendor-side capacity build-up signals.

source_name: PunaIme.org — Kosovo vacancy portal (banking roles)
why_relevant: Carries banking-sector adverts ('Mbikëqyrës bankar', 'Projekt Menaxher') including from smaller banks and microfinance/PSP actors that do not always publish on their own websites.

source_name: PortalPune.com — Kosovo vacancy aggregator
why_relevant: Additional Albanian-language aggregator carrying project-manager and IT roles; useful for redundancy because Kosovo adverts are frequently syndicated across portals with different retention windows.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — careers / vacancies page
why_relevant: Primary-source hiring channel of one of Kosovo's largest banks, including IT & Communications department roles. Group-driven programme staffing (digital channels, card systems, payments migration) surfaces here first and is a leading indicator of vendor selection.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosovo — career section (sq/en/sr)
why_relevant: Bank careers channel published in three languages including Serbian ('Rad u ProCredit Banci'), which makes it one of the few sr-language hiring signals inside Kosovo. Onboarding-programme intakes correlate with operational/IT expansion.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosova — LinkedIn company page
why_relevant: Company posts announce system go-lives, digital-channel launches, partner/vendor collaborations and open roles — the classic 'programme in flight' leak. Employee title changes (e.g. 'Core Banking Project Manager') are equally diagnostic.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association (Shoqata e Bankave të Kosovës) — LinkedIn page
why_relevant: Sector body representing nine commercial banks; announces conferences, working groups and joint sector initiatives (e.g. instant payments, financial-literacy, AML) that precede coordinated procurement across member banks.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association — official website, News section
why_relevant: Authoritative sector pointer: publishes member-bank news, conferences, competitions and joint initiatives, and enumerates the nine member banks — the actor list that drives every other query in this cell.

source_name: Kosovo Banking Association — official Facebook page
why_relevant: In Kosovo, Facebook is often the fastest-updated channel for event announcements and photo/agenda posts naming speakers and sponsoring vendors.

source_name: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo (BQK) — news & conferences
why_relevant: BQK hosts regional high-level conferences (e.g. the 2026 crypto-assets and digital money conference, and the CEE/SEE access-to-finance conference with OeNB/EIB). Agendas and speaker lists identify which infrastructure topics — instant payments, CBDC, crypto regulation — are entering the national roadmap, and which vendors and IFIs are circling.

source_name: Balkan Payment Forum (promoney-events)
why_relevant: Regional payments conference whose agenda features Kosovo's Deputy Governor Dardan Fusha and Balkan Fintech Association figures, with sessions on PSD3/SEPA, instant and mobile payments and bank–fintech collaboration. Sponsor and speaker rosters are a direct read on which payment vendors are courting Kosovo banks.

source_name: STIKK — Kosovo ICT Association (events, KosICT festival)
why_relevant: STIKK represents 100+ ICT firms covering the majority of Kosovo's ICT turnover, and runs KosICT (14th edition reported) plus startup/ecosystem forums. Its member directory and event sponsor lists identify the local integrators that bid on bank and PSP projects.

source_name: Buletini Ekonomik — Kosovo economic/financial news outlet
why_relevant: Covers BQK conferences and banking-sector events in Albanian, often reproducing speaker lists and programme detail not present on institutional sites. Useful as an event-detection tripwire.

source_name: Ekonomia.info — Kosovo business/finance portal
why_relevant: Reports banking-association anniversaries, forums and sector announcements; another sq-language tripwire for event and initiative detection.

source_name: Poslovi Infostud — Kosovska Mitrovica job listings (Serbian-language)
why_relevant: Serbian-language hiring channel covering northern Kosovo, where Serbia-linked banks/branches and Serbian-system employers advertise. Fills the sr-language gap that Albanian portals do not cover.

source_name: Poslovi.rs — Kosovska Mitrovica listings (Serbian-language)
why_relevant: Secondary sr-language vacancy feed for northern Kosovo; provides redundancy against Infostud and different employer coverage.

source_name: UNjobs / DevelopmentAid / Impactpool — IFI and donor procurement-role vacancies for Kosovo
why_relevant: World Bank, IFC, MCC/MCA-Kosovo and EU missions hire Pristina-based procurement specialists precisely when a donor-funded programme with tender pipelines is starting. IFC/SECO are already partnered with BQK on digital financial services, so donor staffing is an early marker of upcoming payment-sector tenders.

source_name: Banka për Biznes (BPB) — corporate site / careers
why_relevant: Mid-sized domestic bank; its own site is the only reliable publisher of its vacancies and digital-programme news. Domestic banks are the most likely buyers of mid-market core/payments solutions.
